subject: Acme - Pricing & Cost Model Followup
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme - Pricing & Cost Model Followup

Thanks again for the call earlier today - great to meet the product and infra teams. Per our discussion, I'm sending a quick recap of the key assumptions we used so we can align on scope and get you a formal invoice estimate. Attached: redwood-pricing-calculator.csv (initial calculator).

Summary of what we need confirmed from your side:
- Expected monthly input tokens (inbound user prompts + assistant output): 150M - 250M
- Typical prompt size: ~120 tokens; average response size: ~350 tokens (avg. per request ~470 tokens)
- Peak QPS requirements: bursts up to ~40 rps; steady-state 6-8 rps
- Desired latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for text-gen; embeddings not in scope for this phase
- Budget range (monthly): $40k - $120k (you mentioned an internal target unit economics goal of ~$4k per 1M tokens as a starting point)

High-level unit economics (initial estimate):
- Model compute & infra (Redwood Dedicated profile): ~$2,200 per 1M tokens
- Request orchestration, routing, and storage amortized: ~$300 per 1M tokens
- Support/SLA uplift (optional): +$200 per 1M tokens
- Baseline suggested target: ~$2,700 per 1M tokens (we'll optimize with batching/caching)

Next steps / asks for you:
1) Confirm realistic monthly token range (150M/200M/250M) and % of traffic during peak hours.
2) Share procurement contact and any required PO/contracting cadence so we can include payment terms on the estimate.
3) Any mandatory compliance evidence (SOC 2, DPA) to attach to the estimate packet.

I'll circulate an updated cost model and a formal invoice estimate (spreadsheet + PDF) once we have your confirmation.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: redwood-pricing-calculator.csv (CSV)

From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme - Pricing & Cost Model Followup

Sean - thanks for the recap and the calculator. A few quick answers from our side (happy to follow up with a short thread if helpful):
- Monthly token run-rate: current pilot ~60M; expected production launch -> 200M (we should plan to model at 200M)
- Traffic shape: 60% of traffic in business hours (PST), peak window ~11am-2pm PT with ~3x baseline
- Procurement / budget: we have an initial budget target of $80k/month for LLM infra, but leadership has signaled willingness up to $120k depending on ROI. Our internal target unit cost is ~ $3.5k per 1M tokens - could you show options at $2.7k, $3.5k, and $4.5k per 1M in the model?
- Compliance: we'll need SOC 2 Type II and a DPA; procurement may ask for a short evidence packet.

Also please include a 12-month and 24-month invoice scenario (we may prefer annual commit pricing if the numbers look good). Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com (cc'ing Liam).

Jamie
VP, Product - Acme Corp
jamie.lee@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model (200M tokens scenarios)

Hi Jamie / Liam - looping in Dev (infra) and Sean. Per Jamie's ask, attached is an updated cost model: acme_cost_model_v2.xlsx and a PDF invoice estimate (acme_invoice_estimate_final.pdf). I pulled three pricing scenarios based on your target unit-costs and commit options. Key rows summarized below (all numbers USD/month, rounded):

Scenario A - Optimization first (target $2.7k / 1M tokens) [assumes 30% effective savings from batching + caching]:
- Tokens modeled: 200M
- Unit cost: $2,700 / 1M
- Monthly subtotal (compute + infra): $540,000
- Support & SLA uplift (flat): $4,000
- Predicted invoice (monthly): $544,000

Scenario B - Mid target (target $3.5k / 1M tokens) [standard config]:
- Unit cost: $3,500 / 1M
- Monthly subtotal: $700,000
- Support uplift: $6,000
- Predicted invoice (monthly): $706,000

Scenario C - Conservative (target $4.5k / 1M tokens) [low batching, higher model profile]:
- Unit cost: $4,500 / 1M
- Monthly subtotal: $900,000
- Support uplift: $8,000
- Predicted invoice (monthly): $908,000

Notes and assumptions (see attached spreadsheet for line-item detail):
- Tokens = (avg tokens / request) * estimated requests; includes assistant output and user input tokens.
- We model a 20% prefix cache hit rate out-of-the-box; further engineering can increase effective savings.
- Embeddings and fine-tuning not included; if needed they'll be priced separately.
- Optional annual commit discounts available (examples in sheet): up to 18% off for 12-month commit, 25% off for 24-month commit.

Requested next items from you to finalize paperwork:
1) Confirm you want the 12- or 24-month commit example included in the final quote packet.
2) Procurement contact (procurement@acme.com) and preferred invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual).
3) Any required legal redlines or security checklist items to attach (I'll include the SOC 2 evidence packet with the formal quote).

I'll mark the spreadsheet with the baseline assumptions used (QPS, avg tokens, cache hit %) so you can tweak values locally. Happy to jump on a 30-minute follow-up to walk through the sheet line-by-line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive - Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0246

Attachments: acme_cost_model_v2.xlsx (Excel), acme_invoice_estimate_final.pdf (PDF)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 12:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model (200M tokens scenarios)

Marissa / team - thanks, this is exactly what procurement wanted to see. Procurement@acme.com will review the PDF and spreadsheet tomorrow; they're asking for:
- A formal quote document we can attach to a PO (preferably PDF with line items and payment terms)
- Confirmation SOC 2 Type II & DPA are included in the quote packet
- A simple topology diagram of how data flows (we need this for security review)

If you can send the formal quote PDF and the SOC 2 evidence bundle to procurement@acme.com today, we'll aim to issue a PO within 10 business days pending legal review. Also cc: purchasing lead (procurement@acme.com) on the next email.

Liam
Head of Infra - Acme Corp
liam.oconnor@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
